TEXT ONLY OR EMAIL ONLY PLEASE. AWARD WINNING developer CRESSEY development in one of the most desirable district, KERRISDALE! McKinnon is Kerrisdale living at its finest!! This 2 bed 2.5 bath home features all of Cressey's luxurious details, such as the infamous Cressey Kitchen, generous sized rooms, well planned layout, top quality finishings, and well thought out designs. WOLF and SUBZERO appliances, wine cooler, and EV Parking. Located in a charming village that offers one of a kind boutiques, restaurants, cafes, upscale boutiques, farmers market, golf course and everything in between. Located close to numerous reputatble schools such as Churchill, Point Grey and Crofton House.
